verdict.rationale: Zoho CRM ships workflows that automatically perform actions such as routing leads or updating fields when events like a deal closing occur. The API also shows that record inserts can trigger these workflows, and Zia can create workflows from requests. missing for 10: detailed first-party docs on rule conditions, trigger types and the action catalog, plus independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: Automate repetitive tasks with workflows. From routing leads to the right rep to updating fields when a deal is closed.
Enter the trigger value as [] to not execute the workflows.
Zia can create modules, reports, and workflows in seconds
